proposed_widenings.name: activation_augment_on_named_feature_use
proposed_widenings.justification: Restoring Touch is not an independently activated class feature. It augments a specific existing activation, Lay On Hands, and spends from that same charge pool during the same use.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you use Lay On Hands on a creature, you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature"

proposed_widenings.name: remove_condition.choose_subset
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing remove_condition surface supports removing one named condition, all listed conditions, or choosing exactly one from a list. Restoring Touch needs choosing one or more conditions from a fixed list in a single activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can also remove one or more of the following conditions from the creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned"

proposed_widenings.name: resource_spent_per_selected_condition
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can express heal amount equals resource spent, but not a side effect whose cost is fixed per selected condition and explicitly competes with healing from the same pool inside the same Lay On Hands activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You must expend 5 Hit Points from the healing pool of Lay On Hands for each of these conditions you remove; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature."

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall. Encoding this as a separate activation would be dishonest because it would duplicate or decouple the Lay On Hands pool and misrepresent the feature as independently invokable.
